scope: Flat serve (automatic model type) plus inherited globals; excludes run/bench/tune/quantize flags. Typed serve subcommands are not emitted by the wizard.

launch_policy.gpu_selection: Only devices granted to this job; preserve scheduler/container mapping; no default host ordinals.
launch_policy.argument_encoding: argv array plus separate env map; never shell interpolation

quality.policy: Prefer the selected checkpoint unchanged when it fits the full workload; otherwise present compatible higher-precision quantization alternatives.

balanced.policy: Use validated tuner candidates; CUDA/CPU preference starts at Q6K, then Q5K/Q4K/Q3K; Metal starts AFQ6, then AFQ4/AFQ3.

speedy.policy: Use validated tuner candidates; CUDA/CPU preference starts Q4K, then Q3K/Q2K; Metal AFQ4, then AFQ3/AFQ2. Faster inference is not guaranteed.

recommendation.environment: Same allocated devices and MISTRALRS_NO_NCCL=1 as serve.
limitations: Estimator, not a benchmark or fit guarantee.
CLI tune does not accept serve runtime/concurrency flags; account for serving workload separately.
Adapters are rejected by tune because their memory is not estimated.
Model/format support varies; unavailable tuning means manual configuration with an explicit unknown estimate.
--quant may select a different published artifact than the ISQ candidate. Recheck its metadata and memory.
Do not silently lower precision or context length after failure.
Upstream quality prefers quantized candidates too; FlexServ must explicitly check the unchanged-checkpoint candidate first.
recommendation.quant_emit: Resolve the chosen supported candidate to an explicit --quant value, or omit quantization flags for the selected checkpoint unchanged. For exact GGUF use --quantized-file, and use --isq only for explicit requantization.

quantization_numeric_mapping.applies_to: Numeric ISQ or quant falling back to ISQ, not necessarily the selected published artifact.
